warnings: Front elevation, viewed from the ก side. Grid bubbles run 1 to 11 left to right, 3.60 m apart, with 0.075 m at each end (the B1 beam half-depth) -- again showing 1..8 then 11 with no grid ⑨ or ⑩, consistent with A-04, A-05 and the structural sheets.

Levels printed on every elevation: ±0.00 ground, +1.00 ระดับพื้นอาคาร (raised floor), +3.50 ระดับท้องอะเส (eave soffit). Vertical chain reads 1.00 (ground to floor), 2.40 (floor to eave soffit), then the roof.

RIDGE HEIGHT is given inconsistently between views on this same sheet: the long elevations (รูปด้าน 1 and 3) dimension the roof as '~2.46' above the eave soffit and mark it approximate, while the gable-end elevations (รูปด้าน 2 and 4) dimension the same roof as 2.25. That is a 0.21 m disagreement. Both are transcribed exactly as printed on their own view; neither was corrected or averaged.

The open lattice below floor level on all four elevations is the raised-floor skirt over the 1.00 m pedestal zone, drawn as diagonal cross bracing between the ตอม่อ -- it matches the C1/C2 pedestals on S-01, not a wall.
